name: Nicodemus
overview: Nicodemus was a male Pharisee and a ruler among the Jews, holding a position of authority within the Jewish religious leadership. His role is significant as he engaged with Jesus during His ministry, reflecting the interaction between Jesus and the Jewish ruling class. There are no additional tribal affiliations or personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Nicodemus appears only once in the Scriptures referenced, with no specific meaning provided. Therefore, his name is simply recognized as a proper name without further elaboration on its significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Nicodemus beyond his identification as a Pharisee and ruler of the Jews. No other personal relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Nicodemus is important in the biblical narrative as a representative of religious leaders who sought understanding of Jesus' message, approaching Him cautiously by night. His interactions with Jesus reveal the necessity of spiritual rebirth. Additionally, Nicodemus demonstrated growing faith by defending Jesus before the Jewish council and assisting in His burial with costly spices, indicating a deepening commitment to Christ.
